notes: Wisdom of Solomon aligns more cleanly than TOB or JDT — 13 of 19 chapters are verse-count-identical between Arabic source Arabic (Vulgate) and English English (Rahlfs LXX). The 6 divergent chapters show small (±1-2) deltas, mostly Vulgate splits of single LXX verses or Vulgate closing-doxology additions.
ch6 has a clean shift-by-1 across ar v25-27 ↔ en v23-25 (Vulgate split en v23 into ar v25-26, leaving the rest shifted up).
ch11 v27 doxology in ar ("O Lord lover of souls") corresponds to en v26's identical content with a one-verse renumbering.
ch19 v21-22 are LXX closing reflections on the Exodus plagues that the Vulgate compressed.
